note: One arm of robotai v1 (our own design, cad/upper.py), shoulder to fingertips. 'match' is a regex on part / joint names in site/models/robot_v1.glb (right arm shown; the left is mirrored). Status: owned = already bought, pending = final pick in progress.

parts.name: Shoulder
parts.actuator: 2× 12V worm-gear motor with encoder (NFP 5840-31ZY class). Self-locking, so it holds the arm up without power.
parts.made: Printed PETG shoulder shell; AS5600 angle sensor + BTS7960 driver per joint

parts.name: Elbow + forearm
parts.actuator: Elbow: 12V worm-gear motor (same class as the shoulder). Inside the forearm: 5× MG996R finger servos with printed tendon pulleys, 3 over 2.
parts.made: Printed forearm shell; ESP32 + PCA9685 board and wiring live inside it

parts.name: Hand
parts.actuator: Pulled by 50 lb PE braid tendons from the forearm servos; springs open the fingers
parts.made: Printed fingers and palm, TPU grip pads on fingertips and palm
